title: Token scale recipe for spacing and type
description: A recipe for deriving spacing and type tokens from a few decisions: a base unit (4 or 8px), a spacing scale built from that unit, a modular type scale from a base size and ratio chosen by density, fluid sizes via clamp() for display text, and semantic aliases (space-inline-sm, text-body) mapped onto the raw scale.
intent: Give a project a small, consistent spacing and type scale that components reference by name instead of literal values.
characteristics: two layers: raw scale tokens and semantic aliases
spacing from a 4px or 8px base with 8-10 steps
type scale from base size and ratio (1.125-1.333)
clamp() for display sizes only, fixed sizes for UI text
line height and letter spacing tokens paired with sizes
interaction: Not interactive. Components consume only semantic aliases; changing the ratio or base unit updates the system.
responsive: Spacing tokens can step up at a breakpoint for section spacing only; component internal spacing stays constant.
accessibility: Body text at least 16px for reading surfaces; sizes in rem so user font settings apply; line height at least 1.5 for body text.
limitations: A scale is a starting point; optical adjustments for specific fonts still matter.
Fluid type can break zoom expectations if min and max are too close; test 200% zoom.
